title: Home Internet & Cellular Network Observability
description: Unified T-Mobile G4SE 5G cellular radio metrics and dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 network latency and availability observability.

panels.title: 5G SINR
panels.description: Approximate cellular engineering thresholds: <0 dB poor, 0-10 dB fair, 10-20 dB good, >=20 dB strong (not a carrier SLA).

panels.title: 5G RSRP
panels.description: Approximate thresholds: <-110 dBm poor, -110 to -100 dBm fair, -100 to -85 dBm good, >=-85 dBm strong.

panels.title: 5G RSRQ
panels.description: Approximate thresholds: <-20 dB poor, -20 to -15 dB fair, -15 to -10 dB good, >=-10 dB strong.

panels.title: Signal Bars
panels.description: Gateway-reported 5G signal bars (0-5).

panels.title: Active 5G Bands
panels.description: Active cellular band label(s) reported by G4SE.

panels.title: Serving Cell & gNodeB
panels.description: Current serving physical cell ID (top) and gNodeB ID.

panels.title: Serving gNodeB ID
panels.description: Current 5G gNodeB identifier reported by G4SE.

panels.title: Gateway Availability (5m)
panels.description: Rolling 5m probe success ratio for local ASUS router and G4SE gateway.

panels.title: Core Internet Availability (5m)
panels.description: Rolling 5m probe success ratio per core_external reference (excludes cloudflare-v4).

panels.title: Current Reference RTT (v4/v6)
panels.description: Latest Google IPv4 and IPv6 ICMP RTT baseline.

panels.title: Monitoring Component Health
panels.description: Scrape status (1=up, 0=down) for exporters and G4SE JSON probe.

panels.title: 5G SINR Over Time (dB)
panels.description: Approximate thresholds: <0 dB poor, 0-10 dB fair, >=20 dB strong. Gaps indicate missing telemetry.

panels.title: 5G RSRP, RSRQ & RSSI Over Time (dBm / dB)
panels.description: Approximate RSRP thresholds: <-110 dBm poor, -100 to -85 dBm fair/good, >=-85 dBm strong. RSRQ in dB on same scale for overlay.

panels.title: Serving Cell ID & gNodeB Changes
panels.description: Tracks tower/sector handoffs (CID shifts or 5m gNodeB change spikes).

panels.title: Cellular Bands, Antenna & Bars
panels.description: Reported 5G band(s), internal/external antenna mode, and signal bars.

panels.title: G4SE API Scrape Health & Latency
panels.description: Distinguishes gateway API unreachability or timeout from radio degradation.

panels.title: Local ASUS Router & G4SE Gateway RTT
panels.description: Local LAN (ASUS 192.168.50.1) vs G4SE cellular gateway (192.168.12.1) ICMP RTT.

panels.title: External IPv4 ICMP RTT by Destination
panels.description: Per-destination IPv4 RTT (never averaged across providers).

panels.title: External IPv6 ICMP RTT by Destination
panels.description: Per-destination native IPv6 RTT (Google, Cloudflare, AdGuard primary/secondary).

panels.title: Rolling Median / p95 / p99 RTT & Jitter (5m)
panels.description: 5-minute rolling p50, p95, p99, and stddev over 5s ICMP probe samples.

panels.title: Local ASUS DNS & HTTPS Application Latency (v4 vs v6)
panels.description: Local ASUS Stubby DoT DNS resolution time vs direct IPv4/IPv6 HTTPS 204 endpoint latency.

panels.title: Individual Probe Success (1 = Success, 0 = Failed)
panels.description: Raw per-probe outcome per target (allows spotting isolated failures vs correlated outages).

panels.title: Rolling 5m Probe Failure Estimate (%) by Target
panels.description: Rolling 5m failed-probe percentage estimate (1 - avg_over_time(probe_success[5m])), not raw packet loss.

panels.title: IPv4 vs IPv6 Availability (5m Rolling)
panels.description: Compares core IPv4 vs IPv6 paths alongside diagnostic cloudflare-v4 to isolate address-family or routing issues.

panels.title: SINR (dB) vs Core External RTT (p50 & p95)
panels.description: Dual-axis view correlating radio SINR (right axis, dB) against core external latency (left axis, ms).

panels.title: Radio Quality (SINR) vs Core Probe Failure Rate
panels.description: Overlays radio quality (dB/dBm) against worst core_external 5m failure rate (%).

panels.title: Serving Cell Changes vs External p95 RTT
panels.description: Checks whether latency shifts coincide with tower/sector CID transitions.

panels.title: Time-of-Day Pattern (Today vs 24h & 7d Ago)
panels.description: Compares current external median RTT against 24h and 7d prior to identify cellular evening congestion vs placement gains.
